rows: 16 August in the 2009 World Championships in Athletics in Berlin, Germany

Equivalent to an average ground speed of 10.44 m/s, 37.58 km/h, or 23.35 mph. Once his reaction time of 0.146 seconds is subtracted, his time is 9.434 seconds, or 10.6 m/s, 38.16 km/h, or 23.71 mph. [ 142 ] Bolt's top speed, based on his split time of 1.61 seconds for the 20 metres from the 60- to 80-metre marks (made during the 9.58 WR at 100 m), is 12.42 m/s, 44.72 km/h, or 27.79 mph. [ 348 ] He also has the second fastest time (9.63) and shares the third fastest time of 9.69 with Tyson Gay and Yohan Blake. Bolt's 9.63 is the Olympic record, set at the 2012 games.

Equivalent to an average ground speed of 10.45 m/s, 37.63 km/h, or 23.38 mph. He ran the last 100 m in 8.70, the fastest ever recorded time over a 100 m distance. This would equal an average speed of 11.49 m/s, 41.38 km/h, or 25.71 mph.
